name: Petaluma Transit: Paratransit
fullDescription: Petaluma Transit provides ADA paratransit service for Petaluma residents who cannot use regular bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Shared ride service within Petaluma
- Fare-free (Petaluma Transit has not charged fares since July 2024)
- Reservations 1-7 days in advance
- Service runs Monday through Friday only (no weekend service as of August 10, 2026)
- Book and track rides with the Access by LumaGo app, or by phone
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Complete a Basic or Medical eligibility application
2. Get the application from Petaluma Transit (707-778-4460)
3. Assessment may be required
4. Once certified, book rides by calling 707-778-4460 or using the LumaGo app
keywords: Petaluma Transit, paratransit, ADA, Petaluma, Sonoma County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
